# What the long tests (*.long.test.ts) run on. A change to any of these runs the long job in test.yml; a
# change to none of them does not. One git pathspec a line. src/sim/longTests.test.ts holds this list to
# the imports of the long tests, so a file they come to depend on has to be added here.
src/sim
src/config
src/office
src/persistence
# Called by src/config/maps.ts, so the test players run on it.
src/mods/mapFile.ts
# What the tests run with.
package.json
package-lock.json
vite.config.ts
tsconfig.json
# The way the long tests are chosen and run.
.github/workflows/test.yml
.github/long-tests.sh
.github/long-tests-paths.txt
